boundaries.title: Trusted validating registry Source
boundaries.contract: Network, deployment code, ABI, upgrade authority and resolver identity are locally pinned; validate full record, proofs, same finalized block, readiness and operation freshness.
boundaries.failure: No validated observation on missing trust, timeout, rollback, inconsistent block or untrusted time.
required_evidence: restart readiness and durable finalized watermark

boundaries.title: Registry Gate to Guard Authority
boundaries.contract: Select the exact issuer/keyid without fallback on every decision; return owned Ed25519 bytes using the same trusted time domain. Recheck freshness at the final dispatch and result gates.
boundaries.failure: Never convert a raw Snapshot flag or an earlier active-key result into current authority.

boundaries.title: Protected capture, policy and signer
boundaries.contract: Capture submitted bytes before untrusted expansion; provision issuer policy and manifest mappings administratively; authorize complete final arguments before intent-bound signing.
boundaries.failure: Missing policy, changed original, unsigned defaults or evaluator failure cannot sign or dispatch.
required_evidence: durable policy epoch and approval mapping
closed tool schema and exact-argument authorization

boundaries.title: Authenticated MCP transport handoff
boundaries.contract: Authenticate negotiated version, peer identity, full RPC bytes and invocation ID. Compare outer sender/recipient with inner issuer/recipient; maintain distinct outer and Guard replay namespaces.
boundaries.failure: Reject mismatched identity, unsupported setup, stale session and missing response correlation; never retry automatically as a new call.
required_evidence: UUID and exact RPC byte binding
outer replay persistence and restart handling

boundaries.title: Durable scope ownership and retirement
boundaries.contract: Share durable replay and execution ownership across workers and transports; serialize approved policy/baseline updates and retirement; reconcile UNKNOWN without automatic execution.
boundaries.failure: Missing ledger or uncertain ownership remains closed; do not recreate an empty ledger or imply rollback of committed effects.
required_evidence: terminal persistence and single client consumption

boundaries.title: Complete effect mediation and immutable loader
boundaries.contract: Bind measurement to the same immutable loaded instance and all loadable dependencies; gate every protected effect independently of model choices or optional hooks.
boundaries.failure: No verdict, exception, disconnect, timeout or unavailable complete mediation denies the protected path and declares the profile unsupported.
